name: How do I choose a reliable storm damage cleanup company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable storm damage cleanup company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a cleanup company, look for certifications from organizations like the IICRC, ensuring they meet industry standards. Check their experience, licensing, and insurance. Read customer reviews and ask for references. A reputable company will provide a detailed estimate, communicate clearly about the process, and offer 24/7 emergency services. Ensure they have experience specifically with storm damage and can work with your insurance provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with IICRC certifications, licensing, insurance, positive reviews, clear communication, and specific experience in storm damage restoration.
